scripts.pm2:start: npm run pm2:start:app && npm run pm2:start:hook && pm2 save
scripts.pm2:start:app: ( npm run build && pm2 delete ${PM2_APP_NAME:-dev-hedge-site} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && pm2 start 'node --env-file=.env server.js' --name ${PM2_APP_NAME:-dev-hedge-site} ) || pm2 restart ${PM2_APP_NAME:-dev-hedge-site}
scripts.pm2:start:hook: pm2 delete ${PM2_HOOK_NAME:-dev-hedge-site-hook} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && pm2 start 'node --env-file=.env github-hook.js' --name ${PM2_HOOK_NAME:-dev-hedge-site-hook} || pm2 restart ${PM2_HOOK_NAME:-dev-hedge-site-hook}
